WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    SUM(t.Bytes) as total_bytes,
    SUM(t.Milliseconds) as total_ms
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(total_bytes) AS FLOAT) / SUM(total_ms) as avg_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  mts.Name,
  CAST(mts.total_bytes AS FLOAT) / mts.total_ms as rate,
  CAST(mts.total_bytes AS FLOAT) / mts.total_ms - oa.avg_rate as exceeds
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE CAST(mts.total_bytes AS FLOAT) / mts.total_ms > oa.avg_rate
ORDER BY exceeds DESC
